Deprecated Functions

Source: R/deprecated.R
biomarkerPanels-deprecated.Rd

Functions retained for backward compatibility. Each forwards to its replacement and signals a deprecation warning. They will be removed in a future release.

get_top_de_features(
  x_list,
  y_list,
  contrast = NULL,
  n_features = 50L,
  combination_method = c("OSP", "Stouffer", "Fisher", "maxP"),
  assay = NULL
)

select_denominator_features(
  x,
  cohort,
  y = NULL,
  n_denominators = 20L,
  n_pcs = 50L,
  batch_pvalue_threshold = 0.1,
  biology_pvalue_threshold = 0.2,
  biology_penalty_quantile = 0.5
)

Arguments

x_list

A matrix-like object, SummarizedExperiment, or list of such objects. Rows represent samples and columns represent features. When a list is supplied each element is treated as an independent cohort.

y_list

A binary response aligned with x_list. Must be a factor with levels c("No", "Yes"). Provide a list when x_list is a list.

contrast

Optional contrast string (or list of strings) passed to limma::makeContrasts(). Defaults to "Yes-No" to align with ensure_binary_response().

n_features

Number of features to return after ranking (default 50).

combination_method

Method for combining cohort-specific z-scores. One of "OSP", "Stouffer", "Fisher", or "maxP".

assay

For SummarizedExperiment inputs, the assay name or index to extract prior to modelling.

x

Expression matrix (samples x genes). Should contain log-transformed expression values.

cohort

Factor of cohort/batch labels, one per row of x.

y

Binary outcome labels for biology filtering. Set to NULL to skip biology filtering (features selected purely on batch association).

n_denominators

Number of genes to select. Renamed to n_features in select_batch_associated_features().

n_pcs

Number of principal components to analyze (default 50).

batch_pvalue_threshold

P-value threshold for batch association. PCs with ANOVA p < this threshold are considered batch-associated (default 0.10).

biology_pvalue_threshold

P-value threshold for biology non-association. PCs with biology p > this threshold are considered biology-free (default 0.20).

biology_penalty_quantile

Quantile of the per-gene biology scores used to stabilise the batch/biology ratio (default 0.5, the median). This acts as a data-driven estimate of the biology-score noise floor; see Details. Larger values weaken the biology penalty, with 1.0 reducing the ranking to batch_score alone.

Value

Character vector of feature identifiers ordered by significance.

A list as returned by select_batch_associated_features(), with the features element additionally exposed under its former name denominators.

Functions

  • get_top_de_features(): Renamed to select_de_features() so that every feature-selection entry point shares the select_*_features() convention.

  • select_denominator_features(): Renamed to select_batch_associated_features(). The old name described the genes' downstream role as log-ratio denominators rather than the selection criterion (association with batch, not biology). The argument order is unchanged, so positional calls still work; n_denominators is now n_features and the returned denominators element is now features.
